notes: Entry: 'early 2021' pre-seed by TechVision Fonds I, Visionaries Club and business angels (automaited/TechVision seed press release of 2022-04-28 on majunke.com; same wording on aachen.digital's success story). Date 2021-01 is 'Anfang 2021' (approximate); amount not published; lead not stated in citable text (a WebSearch summary said Visionaries co-led with TechVision, but no page read says so). Seed EUR 4M, April 2022, led by Headline with Northzone; existing investors Visionaries Club and TechVision Fonds followed on (Gründerszene: 'die bestehenden Investoren, Visionairies Club und der TechVision Fonds, zogen ebenfalls mit'). The later round is a named Seed, so it is not a graduation from the pre-seed. Legal entity aiConomix GmbH (former name), Kennedy-Ufer 11, Cologne, HRB 104508; founded 2020 (press release: 'Das 2020 gegründete Unternehmen mit Sitz in Köln'). Focus: the current product is AI agents for order processing ('Sales Order Processing with AI Agents', site title), so AI & Applied AI; the Headline sibling row has SaaS (from the older RPA framing); judge's call. Personio's Hanno Renner is an angel (Business Insider 2022-06-23 headline).
